description: 4-layer ESP32-WROOM-32E flight controller (Rev 2). Powered by a 2S-4S LiPo battery on XT30 (J1) stepped down to 5V via an MP1584EN DC-DC buck converter (U6) and 3.3V via an AMS1117-3.3 LDO (U2). Includes USB-C (J9) with USBLC6-2SC6 ESD protection (U5) and CH340C USB-UART bridge (U3), an MPU-6050 6-axis IMU over I2C (U4), WS2812B status LED, active buzzer, and PWM/iBUS/GPS/ESC headers.

power_rails.notes: 2S-4S LiPo battery input via XT30 connector (J1) with TVS/reverse protection feeding MP1584EN buck
USB-C VBUS / diode-OR input power rail before Schottky isolation
Regulated 5V rail from MP1584EN DC-DC buck converter (U6) and USB VBUS
Regulated 3.3V digital rail from AMS1117-3.3 (U2) powering ESP32-WROOM-32E and CH340C
3.3V sensor rail powering MPU-6050 IMU and pull-ups

differential_pairs.name: USB_DP_DM
differential_pairs.notes: USB 2.0 full-speed differential pair between USB-C receptacle (J9) and USBLC6-2SC6 ESD protector (U5)

differential_pairs.name: USB_MCU_DP_DM
differential_pairs.notes: USB 2.0 differential pair from ESD protection (U5) to CH340C USB-UART bridge (U3)

design_requirements.decoupling_guidance: Place 100nF/10uF/22uF bypass and bulk capacitors tightly adjacent to VDD pins of U1 (ESP32-WROOM-32E), U4 (MPU-6050), U3 (CH340C), U2 (AMS1117-3.3), and the switching loop of U6 (MP1584EN) + L1 (22uH).
